name: Duolith
source:
Network of all states stops to function today at 3 AM. Third Section of the Public Security Agency is assigned to investigate this act, supposedly of terrorist nature. Agency summons various persons suspected of terrorism. Main character needs to question them and try to find out the truth behind it. 

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-august-2002-ever17-out-of.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
今天凌晨3點，各國網路全面癱瘓。公安局第三科受命調查這起疑似恐怖襲擊的事件。警方傳喚多名涉嫌恐怖攻擊的嫌疑人，主角必須一一偵訊，設法查明事件背後的真相。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-august-2002-ever17-out-of.html]vndbreview[/url]]
